plan.summary: WebChat servisine Automation Flow Builder webhook entegrasyonu ekleniyor. Conversation olayları (created, visitor_message, closed) fire-and-forget HTTP POST ile Automation webhook_trigger endpoint'ine iletilecek. Per-widget flow mapping DB'den (webchat_widget_configs tablosu) 5dk cache ile okunur.
plan.q_intent: WebChat servisinde 3 event noktasında Automation servisinin webhook_trigger endpoint'ine HTTP POST atılacak: conversation_created, visitor_message, conversation_closed. Her widget kendi flow'larına bağlanabilmeli.
plan.interview_notes: Q, her müşterinin birden fazla webchat widget'ı olabileceğini belirtti. Statik appsettings config yerine DB-driven per-widget flow mapping seçildi (webchat_widget_configs tablosu).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AutomationWebhookClient fire-and-forget HTTP POST yapar, conversation akışını bloklamaz
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: _ = discard pattern ile çağrılıyor, tüm exception'lar catch edilip log'lanıyor

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Her widget'ın flow mapping'i webchat_widget_configs tablosundan okunur, 5dk cache ile
widget_id olmayan conversation'lar webhook tetiklemez (backward compatible)
flowId <= 0 olan event'ler skip edilir (per-event disable)
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: AutomationWebhookClient her method'da if (flowId <= 0) return guard

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Error code'lar INV-WC-011/012 arch/errors.md ile senkron

files_changed.change: Added webchat_widget_configs table DDL + widget_id column to conversations
Added WidgetFlowConfig DTO, GetWidgetConfigAsync, widget_id in CreateConversation/GetConversation/CloseConversation, ConversationRow.WidgetId
Automation config reads (URL/timeout only), AutomationWebhookClient DI, ConversationService ctor update, widget_id in conversation creation endpoint
Fire-and-forget typed HttpClient for Automation webhooks with per-call tenantId/flowId
Widget config cache (5min TTL), FireWebhookForWidgetAsync helper, 3 hook points with per-widget config lookup
Added Automation section (Url + TimeoutMs only, flows come from DB)

verification_questions.question: Does the fire-and-forget pattern properly catch all exceptions without crashing the main conversation flow?
Is the ConcurrentDictionary widget cache thread-safe and does it handle cache expiry correctly without memory leaks?
Are conversations without widget_id fully backward compatible with no webhook calls?
Does the CloseConversationAsync RETURNING widget_id correctly handle both closed and already-closed scenarios?

intentional_exclusions: No CRUD API for webchat_widget_configs (managed via SQL for now)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All webhook failures are logged with INV-WC-011/012 error codes. The fire-and-forget pattern is intentional — webhook failures must not block conversations.

aha_moments.user_pain: Webhook failure could silently prevent automation flows from triggering
aha_moments.suggestion: Log every webhook call result (success + failure) with error codes for easy monitoring
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support team opens logs, sees exactly which webhooks failed and why within seconds

aha_moments.user_pain: Per-event DB lookups for widget config would slow down every message
aha_moments.suggestion: 5-minute ConcurrentDictionary cache eliminates DB calls for active conversations
aha_moments.aha_moment: Widget config is loaded once, then served from memory for 300 seconds — zero latency on messages

aha_moments.user_pain: Customer has multiple websites, each needs different automation flows
aha_moments.suggestion: Per-widget flow mapping allows each widget to trigger different flows independently
aha_moments.aha_moment: Customer sees their support widget triggers one flow while sales widget triggers another

aha_moments.user_pain: Hard to debug why a webhook didn't fire for a specific conversation
aha_moments.suggestion: Widget_id is stored in conversation row for full traceability
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support agent traces conversation → widget_id → flow config → webhook log in one query

aha_moments.user_pain: Potential customers want automation that reacts to chat events in real-time
aha_moments.suggestion: Flow Builder can now trigger on chat events, enabling proactive engagement scenarios
aha_moments.aha_moment: Business owner configures a flow that auto-sends a promo when visitor starts chatting on product page
